name: Dolphin Emulator
tagline: Play GameCube and Wii games on your phone
description:
Dolphin plays GameCube and Wii games on Android. It is the long-running desktop emulator, with an official Android build from the same team, so compatibility is good and most well-known games are playable.

You control games with an on-screen overlay or a Bluetooth gamepad, and Dolphin can run them with graphical improvements the original consoles never managed. Save states let you stop and pick up again anywhere.

No games are included — you supply your own, dumped from discs you own. You need a 64-bit phone on Android 7 or later with OpenGL ES 3.0 graphics; Dolphin will refuse to install below that. Wii games in particular ask a lot of a phone, so older devices may struggle.
